summary: Implementation plan to fix Netlify <!DOCTYPE html> JSON parse errors by introducing a dedicated Netlify serverless function (netlify/functions/api.ts), configuring netlify.toml redirects, building a resilient API fetch helper with automatic retries, batched quiz generation (10 questions/batch) to conquer 10s serverless timeouts, client-side PDF text extraction, smart question limits, and client-side fill-in-the-blank fallback.
